text:
Alex: Customer hitting 400 from /v1/invoke with schema error — says params is a string but our schema expects object. They pasted payload in full.
Sanjay: Can you paste the request/response? quick guess: frontend is JSON.stringifying the wrong field.
Alex: Payload they sent: `{"tool":"search","params":"q=test"}`. Response body: `400 {"error":"schema_validation","details":"/params: expected object, got string","error_id":"0x7c3fa"}`
Maya: That explains it. `params` must be an object per tool schema. Did customer say this used to work?
Alex: They claim it worked earlier this week. Wondering if SDK change coerced nested objects to strings. They also reported one call showing auth missing even though header present.
Sanjay: Two possibilities: client bug that built params as a string, or a proxy that form-encodes and converts JSON to query string. Repro locally with curl first.
Alex: Repro steps I used:
1) curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invoke -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"tool":"search","params":"q=test"}'
-> 400 schema_validation `/params: expected object, got string`
2) curl -X POST ... -d '{"tool":"search","params":{"q":"test"}}'
-> 200 OK, result: {...}
Sanjay: Good repro. For the auth issue: do we have ingress logs for error_id 0x7c3fa? might show header drop or duplicate content-length from proxy. I'll check gateway trace.
Maya: I'll open an internal ticket to improve error message to include the expected type and a small example in the error details (so customers can self-fix faster). Filing SD-4217. @eng-runtime can we make schema validation errors more actionable?
SupportBot: Created support ticket SD-4217, assigned to eng-runtime, priority P2, linked to customer case C-98712. ETA 24h.
Julie: Note: tool schemas have `additionalProperties: false` for a bunch of tools — if proxies inject extra keys (like `_metadata`) that will also break. Not the case here but worth flagging in the support reply.
Alex: I'll respond to customer: share repro steps (the working vs failing body), ask them to check SDK version and any proxy or middleware that could stringify nested objects, and ask for a raw request capture if they still see auth missing.
Sanjay: Found gateway trace for request id 0x7c3fa — header present, body payload arrived as string in `params` (looks like client sent it that way). No sign of proxy rewriting.
Maya: Closing loop: client-side bug. Recommend we add an SDK validation warning when params is not an object (quick patch). Also adding example to error text.
Alex: Thanks everyone. I'll update the customer: explain root cause, include fix + workaround (wrap params in object), and link SD-4217 for improvements. :thumbsup:
